description: This file defines the class 'FieldOperator' which extends 'Operator' and is part of the SuiteCRM JSON API filter operators. It includes methods for validating operators, converting them, and handling operator format regex patterns, indicating it manages specific operator logic within the filtering system.

classes.name: FieldOperator
classes.description: A class that handles field operators for filtering in the SuiteCRM JSON API, validating operator strings, and formatting.

methods.name: toFilterTag
methods.description: Converts the given operator to its filter tag by delegating to parent class.

methods.name: isValid
methods.description: Checks if the provided operator string is valid according to the parent class rules. Throws an exception if input is not a string.

methods.name: isOperator
methods.description: Determines if the provided string is a valid operator, with type validation, delegating to isValid.

methods.name: totalOperands
methods.description: Returns the total number of operands after the operator, fixed at 0 for this class.
